Name: Churros
Ingredients: ['1 cup water', '14 cup butter', '1 tablespoon granulated sugar', '12 teaspoon salt', '1 cup all-purpose flour', '2 eggs', 'canola oil (for deep frying)', '12 cup sugar', '2 teaspoons mexican cinnamon']
Instructions: ['In a medium sauce pan combine water and butter and 1 tbs sugar and the salt.', 'Bring to boil over medium heat.', 'As the mixture comes to a boil, add flour all at once and cook, stirring until the batter comes together and away from the sauce pan.', 'Remove from heat and let cool for up to 3 minutes.', 'Add the eggs and beat with an electric mixer until the dough well blended.', 'The dough will be thick.', 'Pour enough oil into a deep fryer of fairly deep frying pan at least 3 inches and heat to 350 degrees.', "Spoon dough into a pastry bag with a 1/2 in star shaped tip or if you don't have a round tip works just as well.", 'When oil reaches temp, pipe out 2 or 3 inch churros right into the hot oil (leaving plenty of room between each churro to evenly cook.', 'Fry approximately 4 minutes or till just golden brown on both sides.', 'Remove from oil and drain on paper towel, then roll in cinnamon and sugar topping.', 'For best results, serve as soon as possible.']

Name: Shrimp cocktail
Ingredients: ['1 large salad bowl', '2 lb jumbo shrimp', '1/2 large can tomato juice', '3 large tomatoes chopped', '2 haas avocados chunked', '1 medium cucumber peeled/seeded/chunked', '1 medium yellow onion diced', '1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves chopped', '1/2 medium green pepper diced', '1 medium jalapeno seeded/chopped you can throw in a few seeds for added heat', '1 tsp finely chopped garlic', '1 oz hot sauce I like Franks red hot', '2 oz ketchup or catsup whatever', '1 splash of citrus soda I recommend fresca or squirt', '1 salt n pepper to taste']
Instructions: ['boil shrimp in salt water (large pot, 1Tbsp salt) if shrimp r precooked defrost fully in cold water instead of boiling them.', 'tips: bring water to boil before throwing shrimp in, they will float to the surface when done.', 'dont leave the shrimp in too long, you want them tender not chewy!', 'cool shrimp in cold water ( ice speeds up the process of coarse.)', 'when cooled, or defrosted, peel shrimp and devein (to devein shrimp, run a paring knife along the outer curve of the shrimp almost 1/4in deep from top to bottom youll see it!)', 'its poop u dont want to eat that part!', 'throw the shrimp in the bowl with all other ingredients, toss well, but gently u dont want to mash the avocado or tomatoes... chill for atleast an hour n enjoy!', 'great with saltine crackers and a slice of lime', 'a great add-in is chunked octopus.']

Name: Black Bean Dip Recipe

Name: Individual Lasagnas
Ingredients: ['4 multigrain lasagna noodles, such as Ronzoni Healthy Harvest lasagna noodles', 'Nonstick cooking spray', '8 ounces ground turkey breast', '1 1/2 cups Roccos How Low Can You Go Low-Fat Marinara Sauce (page 206) or store-bought low-fat marinara sauce', '1 cup fat-free ricotta', '1/2 cup grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese', '1 cup shredded reduced-fat mozzarella cheese, such as Weight Watchers', '3/4 cup roughly chopped fresh basil', 'Salt and freshly ground black pepper']

Name: Blueberry Bliss

Name: Potato Pancakes with Avocado Salsa
Ingredients: ['1 large avocado, peeled and seeded', '2 medium tomatoes, seeded and finely chopped', '4 green onions, finely chopped', '2 Tbs. lemon juice', '1 tsp. red pepper sauce, such as Tabasco', '1 lb. potatoes, cooked and mashed', '3 Tbs. butter, melted', '2 eggs, lightly beaten', '3 onions, finely chopped', '1/4 cup all-purpose flour', '2 Tbs. self-rising flour', '1/2 tsp. Simply Organic all-purpose seasoning', '1/4 tsp. ground nutmeg', '1/4 tsp. red pepper flakes', 'Extra virgin olive oil or cooking spray, for frying']

Name: Salad Greens with Warm Eggs and Pancetta
Ingredients: ['2 tablespoons olive oil', '34 teaspoon balsamic vinegar', '34 teaspoon red wine vinegar', '34 teaspoon red wine', 'salt & freshly ground black pepper', '1 tablespoon olive oil', '12 tablespoon dried herbs, such as rosemary,thyme,basil,oregano', '1 34 ounces pancetta, cut into strips', '3 large eggs', 'coarse salt', 'fresh ground black pepper', '2 cups mixed salad greens, torn into bite sized pieces']

Name: Barramundi With Lemon Basil Sauce
Ingredients: ['4 (4 ounce) fillets barramundi (Asian sea bass)', '1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed', 'Crumb Topping:', '1 cup dried bread crumbs', '1/2 teaspoon seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay)', '1/2 teaspoon garlic powder', '1/2 teaspoon onion powder', '1/2 teaspoon lemon zest', '1 pinch dried thyme', 'Lemon-Butter-Basil Sauce:', '1 cup melted butter', '1/4 cup lemon juice', '1/4 cup white wine', '2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil, or to taste']

Name: Mamas Taco Seasoning
